mapper.select: SELECT TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, FEE_TYPE feeType, TRADE_TYPE tradeType, PS ps, TERM_TYPE termType, CHARGE_TYPE chargeType, CHARGE_BASIS chargeBasis, IS_GRADE isGrade, EFF_DATE effDate, BATCH_SEQ batchSeq, IS_PAY_WITH_TRADE isPayWithTrade, ASSET_CLASSIFY1 assetClassify1, ASSET_CLASSIFY2 assetClassify2, TRADE_PLAT tradePlat, PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, CUSTOMER_ID customerId, IS_MLTI isMlti, BROKER_BAER_FEE brokerBaerFee, COMM_CAL_METHOD commCalMethod, RETENTION_BIT retentionBit, OTHRER_RETENTION_BIT othrerRetentionBit, REMARK remark, CAPITAL_ACCOUNT_NO capitalAccountNo FROM TRD_FEE_CONFIG WHERE BATCH_SEQ = #{batchSeq,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND FEE_TYPE IN ('B01','B02','B03','B04','B05','B06','B07')

SELECT CHARGE_VALUE chargeValue, FEE_MAXI feeMaxi, FEE_MINI feeMini, CHARGE_RATE * 1000 chargeRate, GRADE_AMT / 10000 gradeAmt, GRADE_CONDITION gradeCondition FROM TRD_FEE_CONFIG_DETAIL T1 LEFT JOIN TRD_FEE_CONFIG T2 ON T1.CONFIG_SEQ_NO = T2.SEQ_NO WHERE T2.BATCH_SEQ =#{batchSeq,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND T2.FEE_TYPE IN ('B01','B02','B03','B04','B05','B06','B07')

SELECT distinct m.SEC_ACCT_ID AS id, m.SEC_ACCT_NAME AS text FROM STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO m where m.TRADE_PLACE in ('03','04') and ((m.SEC_ACCT_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{secAcctId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))) or (m.SEC_ACCT_ID like concat('%',concat(#{secAcctId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))))
SELECT distinct m.REGIST_ORG FROM STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO m where m.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secAcctId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.delete: delete from TRD_FEE_CONFIG_DETAIL where CONFIG_SEQ_NO in (select SEQ_NO from TRD_FEE_CONFIG where BATCH_SEQ=#{batchSeq,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select:
select t.customer_id as id,t.customer_name as text from mst_customer_info t where t.IS_BROKER = 'Y'
AND (t.customer_id like concat(concat('%',#{customerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR t.customer_name like concat(concat('%',#{customerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%'))
order by t.customer_id

SELECT tfcd.SEQ_NO seqNo, tfcd.CHARGE_VALUE chargeValue, tfcd.FEE_MAXI feeMaxi, tfcd.FEE_MINI feeMini, tfcd.CHARGE_RATE chargeRate, tfcd.CONFIG_SEQ_NO configSeqNo, tfcd.GRADE_AMOUNT gradeAmount, tfcd.IS_CLUDE_STARTAMT isCludeStartamt FROM TRD_FEE_CONFIG_DETAIL tfcd join (select * from TRD_FEE_CONFIG where BATCH_SEQ=#{batchSeq,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and rownum=1) tfc on tfcd.CONFIG_SEQ_NO=tfc.SEQ_NO order by tfcd.GRADE_AMOUNT
